line_preserving_transcription_without_no.text: God cwæð ēac swilce, “Tēon nū ðā wæteru forð swim-
mendu cynn cucu on līfe, and flēogendu cynn ofer eorðan
under ðǣre heofonan fæstnesse.” And God gescēop ðā ðā
miclan hwalas, and eall libbendu fisccynn and styriend-
licu, ðe ðā wæteru tugon forð on hiera hīwum, and
eall flēogendu cynn æfter hiera cynne; God geseah ðā ðæt
hit gōd wæs. And blētsode hīe, ðus cweðende, “Weaxað,
and bēoð gemanigfielde, and gefyllað ðǣre sǣ wæteru, and
ðā fuglas bēon gemanigfielde ofer eorðan.” And ðā wæs
geworden ǣfen and męrgen se fīfta dæg.

learner_text: God cwæð ēac swilce, “Tēon nū ðā wæteru forð swimmendu cynn cucu on līfe, and flēogendu cynn ofer eorðan under ðǣre heofonan fæstnesse.” And God gescēop ðā ðā miclan hwalas, and eall libbendu fisccynn and styriendlicu, ðe ðā wæteru tugon forð on hiera hīwum, and eall flēogendu cynn æfter hiera cynne; God geseah ðā ðæt hit gōd wæs. And blētsode hīe, ðus cweðende, “Weaxað, and bēoð gemanigfielde, and gefyllað ðǣre sǣ wæteru, and ðā fuglas bēon gemanigfielde ofer eorðan.” And ðā wæs geworden ǣfen and męrgen se fīfta dæg.
